icloud_contacts.title: Fill in names from iCloud Contacts
icloud_contacts.description:
Show the names saved in your iCloud Contacts in the Apple Find contact list in Home Assistant. Apple Find looks up each contact by their sharing email address or phone number. If no name is found, it keeps showing the email address or phone number. To enable this, enter an app-specific password from the same Apple Account. Leave the field blank to turn it off.

[How to create an app-specific password]({password_guide_url})

apple_login.title: Sign in to your Apple Account
apple_login.description: Enter the email address or phone number for your Apple Account and your account password.

apple_verification.title: Apple two-factor authentication
apple_verification.description: Tap Allow on a trusted Apple device, then enter the six-digit verification code shown there. Select Resend verification code to request a new code.
